items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: And that's when Charlie Margulis used to come in there and listen to Al Hurd play.

ctx.x: The one that the. The one that the.

No, no, it's a Ford. This is a Ford, this is the one they named after the song? Edsel. Edsel, oh. Edsel. The one that I did was to play a trumpet. And they came down here to. I had the orchestra for it. And they sent down the key men. The drummer and the trumpet player and the piano player. And all I did was manage the thing. In fact, I was working at the radio station there. And that's when Charlie Margulis used to come in there and listen to Al Hurd play. He says he's got to make it. He says he can't make it…
You ought to see his son. He looks just like him. Is that right? I've seen the picture.
